title: TelemetryInsights
description: Plan 048 Phase 2 — the insights layer (WS001 D1, layer 3). Computed over 1..N saved TelemetryReport JSONs ONLY (never shards/exports/external joins). Every row carries its epistemic envelope {claim, measures_used, n, interval?, caveat}; an LLM never computes a number here. Additive-friendly: additionalProperties is permissive so new sections/fields are non-breaking.

schema_version.description: Pinned envelope version. Bump on a field-set change.

sections.description: The seven WS001 v1 sections, in order.

discipline.description: The v1-committed ritual-marker discipline panel (observe→drain, backpressure-before-implement, checks-before-push, retro cadence).

row.description: The epistemic atom. STRUCTURAL rule: n + caveat are mandatory — a row without them cannot be built or rendered. `values` carries the numbers the HTML renders (a null value = honestly UNMEASURED, never a fabricated 0).

n.description: Sample size behind the estimate (documented per section: invocations/windows for command/skill/stage rows; sessions for work-unit/ratio/outlier rows).

available.description: false ⇒ the per-session grain this section needs was not supplied (aggregate-only input) — a visible, honest degradation, never fabricated.

suppressed.description: Visible note that low-n rows were folded into an aggregate (silent truncation forbidden).

provenance.description: Where the numbers came from + the declared, document-don't-fix gaps.

skipped_inputs.description: Inputs that failed to load — a partial run records each omission here (never silently dropped).
